# FocusCanvas v0.2.2

This patch release fixes task progress recording when a focus session finishes.

## Fixed

- Finishing a focus session tied to a task now marks that task as completed.
- Letting the timer reach `00:00` now records the session and updates task progress automatically.
- The completion timestamp now feeds the handwritten calendar immediately.
- Workspace task counters refresh as soon as task completion is recorded.
- Removed the duplicate timer auto-finish path so countdown completion has one source of truth.

## Unchanged

- Cancelling/clearing a focus session does not complete the task.
- Focus sessions and task completion remain stored locally and continue to participate in optional Google Drive backup/restore.
